findings.title: Synchronous NetworkStream.Write from the main-thread Serve coroutine could stall the frame loop

evidence.mechanism: TransmitResponse is a coroutine that initiates stream.BeginWrite, then yields return null each frame until EndWriteFinished or a ResponseWriteTimeoutMilliseconds (1000 ms) deadline expires, closing the client on timeout. EndWrite is completed on a ThreadPool work item, so the main thread never blocks on a non-reading peer.

testCoverageGapClosed.priorGap: tests covered only silent clients and queued-client overflow, not a non-reading response client

findings.title: JSON serializer emitted control characters below U+0020 literally, producing invalid JSON

evidence.mechanism: AppendString handles the named escapes for quote, backslash, backspace, formfeed, newline, carriage return, and tab, and its default branch emits \uXXXX for every remaining char < 32.

testCoverageGapClosed.priorGap: no test exercised the control-character value class
testCoverageGapClosed.coverage: iterates all 32 control characters, asserts none appears unescaped, and asserts the exact expected escape form for each
